title: ParamFallback
description: Which parameter set an explanation reports as answering when the declared placement parameter head could not be verified (interfaces spec §E, E10): `built-in` (the floor's own set for the kind) or `last-verified` (the last set this floor verified for the scope and kind). Source of truth: this schema; Rust mirror placement_core::ParamFallback (elohim/placement/core/src/params.rs, kebab-case serde). Not named in §2.G's enum list; added because views/placement-explanation-view's `fallback` needs a referenced vocabulary (CONVENTIONS rule 7). Carries neither `_dna` nor `_codegen`: it is a field vocabulary for the placement wire schemas, generated only as a TypeScript union where those schemas inline it, and adds no constant to schema-enums.ts. Not yet pinned: no test holds the Rust enum equal to this list (follow-on: a case in placement-core's schema_contract test).
